S003 remains OPEN. may_close explicitly permits an existence-only asserted ID matching the stored requester or holder. A machine-authorized client can claim a live victim holder's ID, omit pane evidence and quietly close that delivered request. Withdrawal similarly accepts an asserted requester at :255-258.

Caller::bound means ResolvedBy::Pane, but the pane is client-supplied: matching its registered owner/process does not prove which HTTP caller sent the request. Consistent victim pane/ID claims are not independent origin proof.

directory_http.rs:4437-4477 explicitly expects asserted-holder quiet close to succeed and stop limits. Its contradictory-claim negative control does not cover a different caller supplying consistent victim identifiers.

Required repair: independently bind the actual caller before requester/holder/PA/prime authorization. Reject existence-only and uncorroborated victim-pane claims. Add correct-victim-identifier cross-caller controls with unchanged state/notification/limits and a legitimate self/holder positive.
